cohort: 869,079 women (18,715 with COVID-19, 850,364 without COVID-19) who gave birth between March 1, 2020, and February 28, 2021, at 499 US hospitals
finding: Women with COVID-19 during childbirth had higher rates of mortality, intubation, ICU admission, and preterm birth compared to women without COVID-19.
mod_finding: While there was no significant increase in cesarean delivery rates among women with COVID-19, they were more likely to have a preterm birth.
